description_en: Queries the detection result statistics of specified virus scan tasks in batches
description_zh: 批量查询指定病毒扫描任务的检出结果统计
name: ListVirusScanTaskSummary

parameters.help_en: The collection of virus scan task IDs. The collection must contain at least one ID. Duplicate IDs are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 病毒扫描任务ID集合，至少包含1个，不允许重复
parameters.name: task_ids
